critical_code_review_comments: server.py:5953-5976 — Fix H ledger sort applied AFTER Fix D company_mode filter so the mode-filtered array is sorted; sort key falls back date→created_at→'' so undated rows sink to the bottom deterministically. Good defensive coding.

server.py:5917-5947 — Fix D mode filter correctly splits the three cases: mode=all skips company_mode filter but still applies company_id filter; mode=informal requires explicit company_mode==informal (blocks legacy untagged); mode=formal accepts formal OR '' fallback. Matches the review spec exactly.

server.py:5978-6045 — Fix E enrichment uses a single _proxy_get('/api/shipments') roundtrip (cached 3s) then aggregates bag weights by carrier_id across all non-cancelled shipments; allocated_kg round(_,2), linked_bags is a stable list. try/except around the whole block prevents any enrichment failure from breaking /api/trips.

server.py:648-662 — party_meta_upsert uses exclude_unset=True so partial company_name updates don't wipe notes/photo_url/carrier_rates; upsert with $set is idempotent. Response includes 'ok':True + all persisted fields.

party-form.tsx:216-225 + 137/163 — Company Name is stored on BOTH the upstream party doc (best-effort, may be dropped) and the local party_meta overlay (guaranteed). Reopen shows the persisted value via meta merge in server.py:6066-6083. Good belt-and-suspenders design.
global-bottom-dock.tsx:56-60 — Ledger matcher includes p.startsWith('/party/') so party detail pages light up Ledger. /parties (plural) stays under More as intended.

shipments/new.tsx:207-224 — Rate auto-fill fires on both carrier + customer selection AND recomputes carrier_charge on weight change (line 213-224 in the useEffect chain). Uses shared fetchPartyRates from party-rates.ts so shipments+trips share the same source of truth.

shipments/new.tsx:443 + invoice/new.tsx:82,117,470-478 — Fix B save-then-navigate contract is tight: on save success router.replace to /invoice/new?from_shipment=<id>; the invoice screen picks up the param, hydrates from GET /api/shipments/<id>, and marks any bag→item with rate<=0 with red placeholder 'Rate daalna zaroori hai'. Uses colors.danger for both border and placeholderTextColor.

invoice/[id]/pack.tsx — Progress bar drives off packed/total ratio; item chip toggle behaviour: assigning updates ✓ suffix, tapping same chip removes assignment. Confirm button disabled until packed==total. Clean state machine.
